text:
maria: Quick draft for a one-page tenant isolation runbook in the Dedicated docs. Wanted a quick review before I drop it in the handbook.

 tim: Nice. What's the scope? provisioning steps, ops playbook, and config snippets?

 maria: Exactly. Provisioning checklist, CLI and SDK snippets, a tiny state machine for lifecycle, autoscale fallback YAML, and an oncall checklist. Also replaced a stale doc link.

 alex: Paste the state machine here so I can glance. ascii ok.

 maria:
 
 STATE: provisioning_requested
   -> validate_tenant_labels -> allocate_reserved_pool -> provisioning_in_progress
 provisioning_in_progress
   -> capacity_ok -> active
   -> capacity_constrained -> trigger_fallback_policy -> active (degraded)
   -> eviction_detected -> mark_isolated -> migrate_to_reserved_pool -> active
 active
   -> noisy_signals -> apply_rate_limits -> monitor_30m -> (stable) or (escalate)

 sam: Two small asks: 1) include the CLI command for forced migration; 2) a short SDK snippet for updating tenant labels (python + go).

 maria: Added CLI: `rci tenant migrate --tenant-id T123 --target-pool reserved-pool-2 --reason "eviction"` (async; check `rci tenant status T123` until state=active).

 maria: Python SDK snippet:

 ```python
 from redwood import DedicatedClient
 client = DedicatedClient(api_key=os.environ.get("REDWOOD_KEY"))
 client.tenants.update_labels("T123", {"isolation": "reserved-pool-2", "sla": "gold"})
 ```

 Go SDK snippet:

 ```go
 client := redwood.NewDedicatedClient(ctx)
 _, err := client.Tenants.UpdateLabels(ctx, "T123", map[string]string{"isolation":"reserved-pool-2", "sla":"gold"})
 ```

 tim: Also add a short YAML example for an autoscale fallback policy. Call out expected latency tradeoffs.

 maria: YAML included:

 ```yaml
 fallback_policy:
   name: regional-fallback
   triggers:
     - condition: capacity_utilization >= 0.92
       action: route_to_variant
       params:
         variant: quantized-128
         max_routing_pct: 30
   cooldown_sec: 300
 ```

 maria: Note: "Routing to quantized variants can reduce cost but may increase 95p latency by ~20-60ms depending on model family."

 sam: Good. I swapped a phrasing in the SLA from "best-effort" to "best-effort within reserved pool constraints" to avoid ambiguity.

 alex: Add metrics to watch in the runbook (tenant_cpu, kv_cache_miss_rate, inflight_requests) and a 5-item oncall checklist: status -> migrate -> invalidate cache -> monitor traces -> close.

 maria: Done. Also replaced the old google doc link with the archived RFC: https://rwd.com/rfc/isolation-2025

 docs-bot: Draft created: /handbook/dedicated/mini-runbook-isolation.md (preview: https://preview.redwood/docs/handbook/dedicated/mini-runbook-isolation)

 tim: I'll review the PR after stand. If urgent, tag @oncall for faster eyeballs.

 maria: Opening PR now: "docs: mini runbook - tenant isolation and fallback snippets" and assigning to @tim and @alex.

 docs-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/4128

 sam: LGTM. I left a comment suggesting a shorter cooldown (120s) variant for global fallbacks; keeping 300s for regionals seems fine.

 maria: Thanks everyone. Will merge after reviews and then add a brief note to the Dedicated onboarding checklist. :shipit:"
